name: Zola Mabaso
bio:
Zola's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. While studying hospitality management in Durban, she took on a temporary assignment providing meals for a local racing team. The fast-paced environment and the dedication of everyone involved captivated her. She quickly realized that this was where she wanted to be. After completing her studies, she gained experience in high-end restaurants, honing her skills in menu planning, food preparation, and catering logistics.

Zola's approach to catering is rooted in her belief that a well-fed team is a high-performing team. She emphasizes nutritious, delicious meals that cater to specific dietary needs and preferences, understanding the demands of a high-pressure racing environment. Her focus is on providing not just sustenance, but also a sense of comfort and normalcy amidst the chaos. What sets Zola apart is her ability to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the motorsport world, ensuring seamless catering operations regardless of location or circumstance. Her experience and dedication make her an invaluable asset to the Sprint V8 Team.

physical.hairStyle: short, natural afro with neatly trimmed edges
physical.description: Zola is of average height with a warm, welcoming smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipe ideas and dietary preferences.
Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Has a habit of humming quietly while she's prepping food.
